memories.author: D06
memories.text:
function: She reports being able to manage her flower shop independently, stands for 6-8 hours daily, no difficulty with ADLs.
cognition: Mini-Cog score 4/5 (normal), recall of three words intact, clock drawing normal.
falls: No falls in the past 12 months; gait steady; timed up-and-go 8 seconds (normal).
medicines: 1 regular (sertraline 50 mg OD started today).
mood: PHQ-9 score 14 (moderate depression); reports low mood, anhedonia, but denies suicidal ideation.
carers: Mother, Mrs. Lakshmi, lives with her.
goals: "I want to feel happier and have more energy for my work."

memories.author: lab
memories.text: PHQ-9 14; TSH 2.1 µIU/mL (0.4-4.0); Vitamin B12 320 pg/mL (200-900)

memories.author: D06
memories.text:
function: Manages shop well, reports occasional dizziness when rising quickly.
cognition: Mini-Cog not due yet.
falls: No falls in past year; gait steady; timed up-and-go 9 seconds (normal).

mood: PHQ-9 8 (mild); notes improved appetite, still occasional low mood.

memories.author: patient
memories.text: I’ve been feeling better overall, but sometimes I get light‑headed when I stand up fast, especially after mornings at the shop.
